source_level.before: General bounded-degree vertex-transitive-expander cutoff conjecture OPEN; no prior NM13-01 T08 theorem under LIVE20. Historical R16/I0112 had a provisional synchronous-tensor special-class theorem with sqrt(log n) window.
source_level.after: General conjecture remains OPEN. Added a proved source-valid class: line graphs L(G_n) of fixed-degree edge-transitive long-range-expander sequences G_n. These line graphs are bounded-degree vertex-transitive spectral expanders, fail every fixed-c long-range-expansion condition, and have Salez-convention continuous-time cutoff.

mechanism_progress.new_identity: With C=edge-to-endpoint and D=vertex-to-incident-edge, Q_line-I = [d/(d-1)](CD-I) and DC=(I+P_base)/2.
mechanism_progress.obstruction_removed: The extensive endpoint-invisible local-cycle sector ker(D) is a zero-mode of CD and hence decays at exact continuous-time rate d/(d-1); abundant cliques/short cycles and failure of long-range expansion are not by themselves cutoff obstructions.
mechanism_progress.long_range_status: For line degree 2(d-1), singleton balls grow at most O((d-1)^r), while LRE would require a fixed multiple of (2d-3)^r up to mesoscopic radii; therefore no fixed LRE constant exists.
